market_question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Ethereum has strong support above $1500, and with the 2024 halving cycle likely pushing prices higher into 2025, a dip to $1500 would require a severe bear market, which seems less probable than the market implies. Current market structure and institutional adoption suggest a floor well above that level.
evidence_points: ETH has not traded below $1500 since January 2023, maintaining a higher low pattern.
The Bitcoin halving in April 2024 historically precedes a bull year in 2025, with ETH likely reaching new highs, making a sub-$1500 revisit by end-2026 an outlier scenario.
Growing mainstream adoption (ETFs, L2s) provides fundamental demand that should keep ETH above $1500 unless a black swan event occurs.
